distribution.narrative: Lin et al. (2024) provides the first confirmed Chinese records from Shandong, Shanghai and Zhejiang. Liaoning material remains X. aff. trunculus and is not promoted.

host_note: Castanea mollissima is supported by confirmed material. Ailanthus sp. belongs only to unresolved Liaoning X. aff. trunculus.
taxonomy_summary: The current accepted identity is Xylosandrus trunculus Park & Smith, 2020.

taxonomic_history.name: Xylosandrus trunculus
taxonomic_history.note: Current accepted name in the integrated taxonomic backbone.

nomenclature_note: Canonical species is Xylosandrus trunculus Park & Smith, 2020. The earlier Song et al. (1998) usage is a nomen nudum and does not establish the name.
